attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Vermont state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 5 brackets per Vermont Department of Taxes (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Vermont Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.vt_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Head of Household
condition_details.condition_description: Filing Status is MFJ or HOH
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.vt_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /vt_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_rate mul /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_limit sub result.vt_bracket_2_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit min result.vt_bracket_2_limit sub result.vt_bracket_3_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit min result.vt_bracket_3_limit sub result.vt_bracket_4_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit sub result.vt_bracket_5_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_tax /result.vt_state_tax xdef vt_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Vermont tax calculated (Single): $" result.vt_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VT tax for Married Filing Jointly/HOH using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.vt_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /vt_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_rate mul /vt_tax xdef
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_1_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit min result.vt_bracket_1_limit sub result.vt_bracket_2_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_2_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit min result.vt_bracket_2_limit sub result.vt_bracket_3_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_3_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit min result.vt_bracket_3_limit sub result.vt_bracket_4_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit gt { vt_taxable_income result.vt_bracket_4_limit sub result.vt_bracket_5_rate mul vt_tax add /vt_tax xdef } if
vt_tax /result.vt_state_tax xdef vt_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
